name: Living Vengeance
blurb: Innate: When  Varus kills an enemy, he gains  bonus attack speed,  bonus attack damage, and  ability power for a few seconds. The amount is based on his other sources of  bonus attack speed, and is increased on an enemy  champion  takedown.

effects.description: Innate: When Varus kills an enemy, he gains 10% / 15% / 20% (based on level) bonus attack speed as well as bonus attack damage and ability power equal to 11% of his total bonus attack speed for 5 / 7 / 9 / 11 (based on level) seconds, refreshing on subsequent unit kills.

Varus also gains Living Vengeance's bonuses upon scoring a champion takedown, which empowers it for the same duration to grant him 30% bonus attack speed as well as bonus attack damage and ability power equal to 33% of his total bonus attack speed, and an increased attack speed cap of 3.33. Living Vengeance's empowerment may only be refreshed by subsequent champion takedowns.

notes:
Varus cannot gain the standard bonuses while Living Vengeance is empowered. If the buff was active at the time of the empowerment (from scoring a champion takedown), the duration is refreshed while overriding the standard bonuses with the empowered ones.
If Varus kills an enemy unit (non-champion) during the empowerment, he is special cased to gain the buff again after the empowerment expires with the standard bonuses. The re-granted buff lasts for 5 / 7 / 9 / 11 (based on level) seconds minus the remaining duration of the empowered version at the time of the last non-champion unit he killed.
